# notes: Frequency response measured on IEC baffle (DIN45575) at 1 W, 1 m (chart title verbatim); half-space/full-space and the drive voltage are not stated. Note the curve is a 1/12-octave-sampled (probably smoothed) response. Chart title verbatim: "Frequency Response on IEC Baffle (DIN45575) @ 1W, 1 m - Free Air Impedance". Sheet sensitivity row verbatim: "Sensitivity@1W,1m" 8 ohm 97.5 dB, 16 ohm 97.8 dB. The sheet does not state the T/S measurement method, drive level or ambient conditions, nor the voltage behind "1W" (conventionally 2.83 V for 8 ohm, 2.0 V for 4 ohm, 4.0 V for 16 ohm). Uncertainty fields describe transcription only (values are the manufacturer's own numbers, given to 8+ significant figures); the measurement's own uncertainty is unstated. Curve key nominal= is the nominal impedance in ohm of the version measured.
